## English

### New Features

- Use ADM in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French, German, Spanish, or Russian, including the native menus.
- Scan the device for installed management apps when opening Device Owner. Check whether the current owner can be removed and remove it when Android permits.

### Improvements

- Choose an APK, then review its icon, name, version, and package type before installing. ADM recognizes test-only APKs automatically.
- To set a device owner after installation, authorize the receiver once. If the APK contains several receivers, choose one explicitly. ADM checks the device after installation and explains any condition that prevents setup.
- Browse installed app details in Overview and Technical Details tabs. Copy the package name, open the app, or access other actions from the same dialog.

### Fixes

- Keep app details stable while loading and prevent long translations from clipping controls.

## 简体中文

### 新功能

- 界面和原生菜单支持英语、简体中文、繁体中文、日语、法语、德语、西班牙语和俄语。
- 展开「设备所有者」时自动扫描设备上已安装的管理应用。已有所有者时，可检查移除条件，并在 Android 允许时移除。

### 改进

- 安装应用分为选包和确认两步。安装前可核对图标、名称、版本和包类型，测试包自动识别。
- 安装后配置设备所有者只需授权一次。APK 含多个管理接收器时可指定一个；安装成功后自动检查设备条件，不满足时显示具体原因。
- 应用详情分为「概览」和「技术信息」，可复制包名，也可在弹窗底部打开应用或使用更多操作。

### 修复

- 修复应用详情在读取完成时突然改变大小，以及较长译文导致部分控件被截断的问题。
